---
title: "02 — Prepare time-ordered datasets"
output: html_notebook
---

**Measures:** outcome eligibility, retained missing-predictor categories, and train/validation/calibration year sizes. Training uses 2014–2022, model choice uses 2023, and calibration uses 2024. The separate 2025 outcome is not loaded here.


## Setup
Loads the unchanged input settings, shared model functions, and the persistent run increment. The output suffix identifies this run.

```{r setup}
# Set the project root, then load R code from the shared R Notebooks.
find_project_root <- function(start = getwd()) {
    current <- normalizePath(start, mustWork = TRUE)
    repeat {
        if (file.exists(file.path(current, "FMD_Project.Rproj"))) {
            return(current)
        }
        parent <- dirname(current)
        if (identical(parent, current)) {
            stop("Open FMD_Project.Rproj in RStudio first")
        }
        current <- parent
    }
}

project_root <- find_project_root()
knitr::opts_knit$set(root.dir = project_root)

load_module <- function(name) {
    path <- file.path(project_root, "R", paste0(name, ".Rmd"))
    text <- readLines(path, warn = FALSE)
    starts <- which(startsWith(text, "```{r"))
    ends <- which(trimws(text) == "```")
    blocks <- lapply(starts, function(start) {
        finish <- ends[ends > start][1]
        if (is.na(finish) || finish <= start + 1L) {
            stop("Missing code or closing fence in ", path)
        }
        paste(text[(start + 1L):(finish - 1L)], collapse = "\n")
    })
    eval(parse(text = paste(blocks, collapse = "\n\n")), envir = parent.frame())
    invisible(TRUE)
}

load_module("config")
load_module("run_manager")
load_module("helpers")
run_context <- attach_run()
cat("[RUN] Current increment:", run_context$id, "\n")
```


## Create chronological datasets

Retains unknown predictor responses as `Missing`. Excludes only unknown FMD labels or invalid weights for supervised learning. Samples the large training cohorts without using FMD to decide which records are selected.

```{r create-chronological-datasets}
check_packages("data.table")
historical <- read_historical()
historical <- historical[valid_weight(RAW_WEIGHT)]

# Use one feature schema in every year. Race is not a model input.
historical <- prepare_features(historical)
training_data <- historical[YEAR %in% development_years & valid_outcome(FMD)]

set.seed(seed)
training_data <- sample_development(training_data)
validation_2023 <- historical[YEAR == selection_year & valid_outcome(FMD)]
calibration_2024 <- historical[YEAR == calibration_year & valid_outcome(FMD)]

# Independent later-year survey weights are used for 2023 and 2024 metrics.
validation_2023[, train_weight := RAW_WEIGHT]
calibration_2024[, train_weight := RAW_WEIGHT]

save_once_rds(training_data, "checkpoints", "02_development")
save_once_rds(validation_2023, "checkpoints", "02_selection_2023")
save_once_rds(calibration_2024, "checkpoints", "02_calibration_2024")

sizes <- data.table::rbindlist(list(
    training_data[, .(stage = "training", n = .N), by = .(YEAR, cohort)],
    validation_2023[, .(stage = "selection", n = .N), by = .(YEAR, cohort)],
    calibration_2024[, .(stage = "calibration", n = .N), by = .(YEAR, cohort)]
))
save_table(sizes, "02_retained_samples")
print(sizes)
rm(historical)
gc(verbose = FALSE)
```
